Class DefaultLogConfig.Builder

java.lang.Object
tij.jca.logging.DefaultLogConfig.Builder
Enclosing class:
DefaultLogConfig
public static final class DefaultLogConfig.Builder extends Object
Builder for creating immutable DefaultLogConfig instances.

The builder uses the following defaults:

  • LogLevel.INFO as the minimum log level
  • Logging enabled
  • Stack traces enabled
  • No output path
